categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Jinma Entertainment Corporation Limited primarily operates in two main segments: manufacturing of large amusement facilities and virtual immersive amusement projects, and investment and operation of cultural tourism projects. The company offers a comprehensive range of amusement products including roller coasters, flying towers, Ferris wheels, VR series, and other immersive experiences. It also engages in the investment, construction, and operation of differentiated cultural tourism projects such as family parks and amusement carnivals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including VR, AR, MR, and artificial intelligence to develop immersive amusement products. It has proprietary core technologies at domestic leading and international advanced levels, with a full product matrix covering 13 categories of large amusement facilities and 8 series of virtual immersive projects. Manufacturing follows strict quality control and safety standards, including ISO9001, EU EN 1090 certification, and TUV safety certifications, with production bases specialized for large and virtual products. The production cycle ranges from under one year for small to medium products to 1-1.5 years for large, customized products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include theme parks, amusement parks, cultural tourism scenic spots, commercial complexes, and technology experience centers. It serves both domestic high-end amusement parks and international markets, exporting to nearly 50 countries including Europe, America, Southeast Asia, Middle East, and Latin America. The company also targets urban and scenic area leisure consumers through its investment and operation projects, focusing on family-oriented and differentiated cultural tourism formats.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant presence in Guangdong province and other regions including Hunan, Hubei, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Wuhan, and others. It has established subsidiaries and marketing channels in Hong Kong, Switzerland, Southeast Asia, North America, Latin America, and other emerging markets. The international business has shown rapid growth, with exports and overseas projects expanding notably in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Jinma Entertainment Corporation Limited operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the amusement industry supply chain. It is involved in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, installation, and after-sales service of amusement equipment, as well as investment, construction, and operation of cultural tourism projects, thus covering both product supply and end-user service delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven development, focusing on high-end amusement equipment and digital immersive products integrating AI and VR technologies. It aims to enhance product quality, expand international markets, and develop high cost-performance products for lower-tier markets. R&D efforts include new motion forms, structural and process innovations, and digital transformation of existing products. The company also prioritizes management reforms to improve efficiency and supports sustainable growth through ESG principles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of amusement equipment and virtual immersive products, including customized large-scale facilities. Additional revenue streams include investment and operation income from cultural tourism projects, ticket sales, service fees, leasing income, and sales of parts and maintenance services. The company recognizes revenue upon product installation, inspection, and customer acceptance, with staged payments based on contract milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player and the first amusement equipment manufacturer listed on the A-share market. It holds a dominant position in the domestic high-end amusement equipment market, especially in roller coasters, achieving significant import substitution. It is the exclusive Chinese supplier for international top theme parks like Universal Studios and actively participates in national industry standards formulation. The company differentiates itself with a full product matrix and integrated manufacturing and operation capabilities, competing with many smaller firms focused on single product categories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 577 million, a 21.88% decrease from 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 7.35 million, down 84.07%. Despite revenue decline, operating cash flow increased significantly by 654.68% due to improved receivables management. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.36 billion, with equity of RMB 1.38 billion. New orders increased by 42.35% year-over-year, with a strong order backlog of RMB 1.37 billion, indicating growth potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive and diversified product portfolio with proprietary core technologies that meet domestic and international safety and quality standards. It provides high-quality, innovative amusement equipment that replaces imports and caters to customized client needs. Its integrated 'manufacturing + cultural tourism' strategy enables one-stop solutions from product design to operation, enhancing customer experience and project value. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, global marketing network, and commitment to ESG principles further differentiate it in the competitive amusement and cultural tourism market.
